title: Gen Agent hooks
description: Project hooks (`.gen/hooks.json`). beforeSubmit / beforeShell / session.compacting / shell.env veto on exit ≠ 0; session.diff / file.watcher are notify-only. Env: GEN_HOOK_EVENT + event-specific vars. shell.env stdout: JSON {"env":{...}} or KEY=value.

hooks.description: Optional wrapper; top-level event keys are also accepted.

beforeSubmit.description: Veto on non-zero exit. Env: GEN_HOOK_TEXT.

beforeShell.description: Veto on non-zero exit. Env: GEN_HOOK_COMMAND.

shell.env.description: Before run_command spawn. Env: GEN_HOOK_COMMAND, GEN_HOOK_CWD. stdout JSON {"env":{K:V}} or KEY=value merges into process env. Exit ≠ 0 vetoes.

file.watcher.description: Notify-only (debounced). Env: GEN_HOOK_PATH, GEN_HOOK_FILE_EVENT, GEN_HOOK_PATHS, GEN_HOOK_FILE_EVENTS.

matchers.description: Run when any matcher matches. Strings are case-insensitive * / ? globs against the event subject (GEN_HOOK_COMMAND for beforeShell, GEN_HOOK_TEXT for beforeSubmit). Object fields are ANDed.

pattern.description: Glob against the event's primary subject.

cwd.description: Glob against the hook working directory.
